item.title: [LAIKA Studios] Wildwood – Official Trailer
item.description:
How far would you go for those you love?

Experience Wildwood, in theatres everywhere October 23.

From the makers of Coraline, Wildwood is a sweeping, darkly magical adventure about Prue, a young girl who journeys into a hidden forest to rescue her younger brother. Along the way she encounters warring factions, extraordinary creatures, and a world unlike anything she's ever known.

Sign up to be first in line for tickets and new experiences at https://wildwoodmovie.com.

item.title: [IFC Films] THE STUNT DRIVER Trailer | Jay Baruchel, Ben Foster, Ed Helms | Independent Film Company
item.description:
Set in the mid-seventies, THE STUNT DRIVER recounts the true underdog story of Canada’s Ken Carter, the world champion stunt driver who battles personal demons and public doubt to attempt what everyone considers impossible – a mile-long jump across the St. Lawrence river in a rocket car.

Directed by: Michael Dowse
Starring Jay Baruchel, Laurence Leboeuf, Dan Bakkedahl, with Ben Foster and Ed Helms

In theaters September 25

item.description:
At the start of her new job in a luxury retirement community, Eleni is drawn into a series of scam calls targeting the elderly residents. As the community's strange rhythms close around her, she grows increasingly intimate with her elusive patient, Douglas, until the line blurs between care and desire, devotion and delusion.

Written & Directed by: Georgia Bernstein

Starring: Cemre Paksoy, Bruce McKenzie, and Mimi Rogers.

[IFC Films] CHUM | Official Trailer Ft. Alice Eve | Independent Film Company
item.description:
In Theaters and Everywhere You Rent Movies June 5th

A dream destination wedding in Malta explodes into chaos when a bloodthirsty shark attacks and a sinister fisherman with a hidden agenda turns the celebration into a deadly trap. Forced between open water and a relentless human predator, the wedding party must fight for survival as secrets surface and loyalties shatter. As the newlyweds are pushed to their limits, they’re forced to confront the cracks in their relationship to determine who lives, who dies and who stays married.

Directed by Jonathan Zuck

Story By James Kondelik, Ryan R. Johnson & Dick Grunert

Screenplay by Jonathan Zuck & Joe Leone

Starring Alice Eve, Eric Michael Cole, Elle Haymond, Sarah Siadat, Johnny Gaffney, Lisa Yaro, Jim Klock
